title: AgencyPulse: white-label website health, security and accessibility reports for web agencies
source: Top 25 SaaS ideas for Victor (research report, Nov 2026)
summary: One monthly report with the agency's logo on every client website (uptime, security, expiry dates, speed and EU accessibility) that web agencies resell to clients as a "care plan".
hook: "A client's SSL certificate expired on a Saturday and they found out from their customers, not from us."
story:
**Marco runs a 5-person web agency in Berlin that maintains 60 client sites** on WordPress, Webflow, Shopify and a few Next.js builds. He sells "care plans", but reporting to clients means logging into different tools for each stack and pasting screenshots into a monthly email.

Since the **European Accessibility Act** became enforceable, shop clients ask whether their checkout is compliant; German shops have already received warning letters. With AgencyPulse, every site gets one **outside-in report with Marco's logo**: uptime, SSL and domain expiry, email security, exposed files, speed, and honest accessibility checks on the checkout, plus AI fix suggestions.
whyNow: The European Accessibility Act has been enforceable since 28 June 2025, and its second year of enforcement began on 28 June 2026. Sweden's regulator PTS opened its first e-commerce cases, German shops received warning letters, and a July 2026 article says most businesses are "still catching up".
evidence: The EAA has been enforceable since 28 June 2025; Sweden's PTS opened its first e-commerce cases and German shops received warning letters [Disability World / TestParty]
Most businesses are "still catching up" one year after the EAA (July 2026) [KEYT/Stacker]
WP Umbrella charges €1.99 per site per month for white-label WordPress maintenance reports [WP Umbrella]
ManageWP has a free core with paid per-site add-ons such as +$2 for backups and +$1 for uptime [Gautam Khorana]
62% of second-year EAA sanctions targeted checkout flows (single editorial source, unverified) [Disability World]
Very small firms (under 10 staff and up to €2M turnover) are exempt for services, which shrinks the EU market [fudge.ai]

solution.title: Add sites
solution.text: paste a list or upload a CSV of client sites.

solution.title: Scheduled outside-in checks
solution.text: uptime, SSL/domain/DNS expiry, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, security headers, exposed files (.git, .env), outdated JavaScript libraries and CMS versions, Core Web Vitals, broken links.

solution.title: Accessibility tests
solution.text: axe-core with Playwright on key pages, including a scripted checkout.

solution.title: AI fix suggestions
solution.text: plain-English fixes, alt-text drafts and an accessibility statement generator.

solution.title: Alerts
solution.text: instant alerts for downtime and expiries.

solution.title: White-label report
solution.text: monthly PDF and web report with the agency's logo.
